mapper.select:
/** qustnr-mapper.getQustnrListCnt (설문 목록 총 개수) */ SELECT COUNT(QUSTNR_SN) FROM G_QESTNAR WHERE 1=1
AND QUSTNR_SJ LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchTxt} , '%')

/** qustnr-mapper.getQustnrList (설문 리스트) */
SELECT QUSTNR_SN ,QUSTNR_SJ ,QUSTNR_PURPS ,DATE_FORMAT(QUSTNR_BGN_DE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS QUSTNR_BGN_DE ,DATE_FORMAT(QUSTNR_END_DE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS QUSTNR_END_DE ,DATE_FORMAT(FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM ,SRVY_TRGT FROM G_QESTNAR WHERE 1=1
AND QUSTNR_SJ LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchTxt} , '%')
ORDER BY FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC

/** qustnr-mapper.getQustnr (설문 상세) */ SELECT QUSTNR_SN ,QUSTNR_SJ ,QUSTNR_PURPS ,QUSTNR_BGN_DE ,QUSTNR_END_DE ,FRST_REGIST_PNTTM ,(CASE WHEN QUSTNR_BGN_DE <= CURRENT_DATE AND QUSTNR_END_DE >= CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_SHOW ,(SELECT NVL(MAX(GQQ.QUSTNR_QESITM_SN),0) + 1 FROM G_QUSTNR_QESITM GQQ WHERE GQQ.QUSTNR_SN = GQ.QUSTNR_SN ) AS MAX_QESITM ,SRVY_TRGT FROM G_QESTNAR GQ WHERE 1=1 AND QUSTNR_SN = #{qustnrSn}

/** qustnr-mapper.getQustnrQesitmDetail (설문 질문, 답변 상세) */ SELECT GQQ.QUSTNR_SN ,GQQ.QUSTNR_QESITM_SN ,GQI.QUSTNR_IEM_SN ,GQQ.QESTN_SN ,GQQ.QESTN_TY_CODE ,GQQ.QESTN_CN ,GQQ.PARENT_SN ,GQI.IEM_SN ,GQI.IEM_CN
,(select qustnr_iem_sn from G_QUSTNR_RSPNS_RESULT gqrr where gqrr.qustnr_sn = GQQ.qustnr_sn and gqrr.qustnr_qesitm_sn = GQQ.qustnr_qesitm_sn and gqrr.user_id = #{userId}) as selected
,( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM G_QUSTNR_RSPNS_RESULT GQRR WHERE GQRR.QUSTNR_SN = GQI.QUSTNR_SN AND GQRR.QUSTNR_QESITM_SN = GQI.QUSTNR_QESITM_SN AND GQRR.QUSTNR_IEM_SN = GQI.QUSTNR_IEM_SN ) AS USER_CNT
FROM G_QUSTNR_QESITM GQQ INNER JOIN G_QUSTNR_IEM GQI ON GQQ.QUSTNR_SN = GQI.QUSTNR_SN AND GQQ.QUSTNR_QESITM_SN = GQI.QUSTNR_QESITM_SN WHERE GQQ.QUSTNR_SN = #{qustnrSn} ORDER BY QESTN_SN, GQI.IEM_SN

/** qustnr-mapper.getQustnrRspnsResultCnt (설문 총인원 가져오기) */ SELECT COUNT(1) AS CNT FROM ( SELECT QUSTNR_SN ,USER_ID FROM G_QUSTNR_RSPNS_RESULT WHERE QUSTNR_SN = #{qustnrSn} GROUP BY QUSTNR_SN , USER_ID ) A

/** qustnr-mapper.insertQustnrRspnsResult (설문 제출 전 기간 및 등록 여부 체크) */ SELECT QUSTNR_SN ,QUSTNR_SJ ,QUSTNR_PURPS ,QUSTNR_BGN_DE ,QUSTNR_END_DE ,FRST_REGIST_PNTTM ,(CASE WHEN QUSTNR_BGN_DE <= CURRENT_DATE AND QUSTNR_END_DE >= CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS IS_SHOW ,(SELECT NVL(MAX(GQQ.QUSTNR_QESITM_SN),0) + 1 FROM G_QUSTNR_QESITM GQQ WHERE GQQ.QUSTNR_SN = GQ.QUSTNR_SN ) AS MAX_QESITM ,SRVY_TRGT ,NVL(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM G_QESTNAR WHERE QUSTNR_SN = #{qustnrSn} AND QUSTNR_BGN_DE <= CURRENT_DATE AND QUSTNR_END_DE >= CURRENT_DATE ), 0) AS qustnrCnt ,NVL(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM G_QUSTNR_RSPNS_RESULT WHERE QUSTNR_SN = #{qustnrSn} AND USER_ID = #{userId} ), 0) AS regCnt FROM G_QESTNAR GQ WHERE 1=1 AND QUSTNR_SN = #{qustnrSn}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM G_QUSTNR_QESITM WHERE QUSTNR_SN = ${qustnrSn} AND QUSTNR_QESITM_SN = ${qustnrQesitmSn}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM G_QUSTNR_IEM WHERE QUSTNR_SN = ${qustnrSn} AND QUSTNR_QESITM_SN = ${qustnrQesitmSn}
